answer_1.quote: In the pursuit of achieving state-of-the-art results in Neural Machine Translation (NMT)... We conduct experiments on the OPUS multi-domains dataset, which includes German-English parallel data in five domains: Medical, Law, IT, Koran and Subtitles. We also use WMT14 de-en data for pruning and WMT'19 German-English as the pretrained model.
answer_1.outputs: German-to-English translated sentences evaluated with BLEU

answer_2.quote: We adopt the BLEU score to evaluate the translation performance. Recognizing that post-training BLEU may not sufficiently capture the nuances in multi-stage CL, we introduce two additional metrics: Forgetting Ratio (FR) and Saturation Ratio (SR).
